notes.title: ZeroFactory - Demo & Kickstarter !
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][/p][h1]🎉 The Zero Factory Demo is back![/h1][p]Hello Survivors & Builders,[/p][p]We are excited to announce that the [b]Zero Factory demo is now available again on Steam[/b]! 🌍✨[/p][p]This new version has been [b]reworked from the ground up[/b] to reflect the latest vision of the game and to celebrate the launch of our [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b].[/p][p]🔧 What’s new?[/p][list][*][p]A polished experience with better flow[/p][/*][*][p]A fresh start that matches the new design & direction[/p][/*][*][p]A sneak peek at the journey from cozy survival to automated industry[/p][/*][/list][p]👉 Play the demo here: [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]And if you want to support the project and help us bring Zero Factory to life, check out the Kickstarter: 💚 [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mysterysoulsprod/zero-factory"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mysterysoulsprod/zero-factory[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your amazing support — together we’re building this adventure! 🚀[/p]
